scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --input-type=module -e "import { copyFileSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const f of ['openapi.yaml', 'openapi.v3.yaml']) copyFileSync('src/' + f, 'dist/' + f)"
scripts.test: tsx --test test/accounts.contract.ts test/deals.contract.ts test/activity.contract.ts test/tickets.contract.ts test/quotes.contract.ts test/campaigns.contract.ts test/search.contract.ts test/tenancy.isolation.ts
